end.parentNote: Asha practised equal groups using plates, laddoos, jalebis, and samose. Rohan used repeated counting to find totals, including 2, 4, 6 and 4, 8, 12; the skip-counting mix-up was corrected later when the picture was shown. At home, make small groups of buttons or snacks and ask, “How many in each group, and how many altogether?”
